text:
Kathy takes the Miami condominium outright by survivorship under the tenancy by the entirety Bill created when he signed and delivered the deed. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture under the will, and Tommy and Julie share every other asset equally. Kathy’s prenuptial agreement waives her elective-share, pretermitted-spouse, and homestead rights, so the probate estate passes entirely under the will.
CONFIDENCE: 84
